content: [observation] -> Declaring DeFi "74% safer" while major exploits still happen weekly feels like a victory lap mid-marathon. -> [impact] -> Breeds dangerous complacency; teams and users relax vigilance. -> [suggestion] -> Shift the metric from "losses down" to "attacks prevented." Build fortresses, not just count the holes.
